messages:
rachel: Hey team — kicking off Halo activation. Objective: get a single end-to-end flow validated in 30 days, surface renewal/PO risks early, and finalize enablement plan. Who's taking what?

omar: I can lead the integration. Need sample dataset and API keys. @rachel do they have sandbox only or can we spin a trial cluster?

rachel: Sandbox only for now. Sales is working PO for a 30-day trial cluster; might take 1-2 weeks. I'll follow up and flag any delay.

joy: I'll run enablement and post-launch feedback capture. Plan: discovery week 1, integration week 2, validation week 3, launch prep week 4. Agree?

mike: From product: success criteria — 1) core 8 intents ≥ 90% accuracy on their test set, 2) p95 latency <400ms under validation load, 3) no sev1 defects at release. If they require custom reranking, timeline will shift.

samir: Ops note — procurement/legal often hold up the PO until DPA complete. If PO delayed >10 days mark renewal risk. Suggest we run parallel sandbox validation to avoid blocking everything.

omar: Request: can someone share expected traffic shape? sequence lengths + qps peaks. I'll size our tests accordingly.

rachel: Sales shared a baseline: 80% <100 tokens, spikes to ~250 tokens during batch ops, steady-state ~30 qps. I'll add to the shared folder.

onboard-bot: ACTIONS CREATED:
- omar -> infra checklist & sample traffic plan (due 3d)
- joy -> enablement slide deck + power-user session (due 6d)
- rachel -> confirm PO ETA with AE & add renewal tag (due 2d)
- mike -> provide acceptance test templates (due 4d)

joy: Tentative enablement slots: Thu 11am PT (Eng) or Fri 9am PT (PMs). Which works?

omar: Thu 11am PT good. I'll add infra notes to the invite.

mike: Posted acceptance test templates to the Halo folder. Includes sample prompts and pass/fail criteria.

samir: I've added a renewal-risk flag in CRM tied to the PO timeline. If PO slips >10d we schedule a risk review with AE and AM.

rachel: Quick recap: 30-day target, owners: omar (tech), joy (enablement), mike (product), rachel (CS). Top risks: PO/DPA delay, telemetry gaps, dataset access. Mitigation: parallel sandbox validation + early SRE office hours if needed.

onboard-bot: REMINDER: omar infra checklist due in 3 days.

rachel: Thanks team — I'll send a short note to Halo and AE summarizing owners and risks. Drop blockers here.
